name: Calm density
fit: Info-rich tools with quiet chrome (Linear / Stripe / Vercel class).
feel: More information, less decoration. Restrained, confident, quiet.
surfaces: Solid, low-ornament panels. Tight spacing. Minimal chrome.
type: Strong hierarchy, compact body. Little display flair.
color: Muted neutrals; one or two accents. No rainbow UI.
depth: Flat to barely raised. Shadows only for overlays.
bestFor: Issue trackers, billing, infra, dense SaaS workspaces.
avoid: Decorative gradients, heavy glass on data tables, loud illustration.
adapt: Keep quiet density; swap accent and type for this product.
